units.source_text: 御苑中菊花经霜后色泽变得更鲜，正是盛开之时。

en.t: In the imperial garden, the chrysanthemums had grown brighter in color after the frost and were just in full bloom.

units.source_text: 天色凄凉，降下一阵时雨。

en.t: The sky looked bleak, and a passing shower began to fall.

units.source_text: 今上记挂二公主，走到她房中，和她闲谈往事。

en.t: The reigning emperor was concerned for the Second Princess, so he went to her room and chatted with her about old times.

units.source_text: 二公主对答从容不迫，全无稚气，今上觉得非常可爱。

en.t: The Second Princess answered calmly and without the least childishness, and the emperor found her very endearing.

units.source_text: 他想：“这样一个窈窕淑女，世间不会没有赏识、爱护的人。”

en.t: He thought, "For such a graceful and virtuous young lady, there must surely be someone in the world who would appreciate and cherish her."

units.source_text: 便回忆起他的父帝朱雀院将女儿三公主嫁与六条院源氏大人的故事来，

en.t: He then recalled how his father, Emperor Suzaku, had married his daughter, the Third Princess, to Lord Genji of Rokujo-in,

units.source_text: 想道：“一时间虽然有人讥评，说：‘啊呀，皇女下嫁臣下，多么不体面啊！

en.t: and thought, "At the time, some people criticized it, saying, 'Oh dear, how improper it is for an imperial princess to marry down to a subject!
Would it not have been better to leave her unmarried?'

units.source_text: 但现在看来，那源中纳言人品超群出众，

en.t: But looking at it now, that Genji Middle Counselor is outstanding in character, far above others,

units.source_text: 三公主一切全仗这儿子照顾，昔日声望毫不衰减，依然度着高贵的生涯。

en.t: and the Third Princess relies entirely on this son for care; her former prestige has not declined at all, and she still lives a noble life.

units.source_text: 当初倘不嫁与源氏大人，难保不发生意外之事，自会遭受世人的轻侮呢。”

en.t: If she had not been married to Lord Genji in the beginning, some unforeseen trouble might well have occurred, and she would naturally have suffered the contempt of the world."

units.source_text: 左思右想了一会，决心要趁自己在位期间为二公主选定驸马：

en.t: After pondering the matter from every side for a while, he resolved to choose a husband for the Second Princess while he was still on the throne:

units.source_text: 就照朱雀院选定源氏的办法，这驸马除了薰中纳言之外别无更好的人了。

en.t: following the example of Suzaku-in choosing Genji, there could be no better husband for her than Kaoru, the Middle Counselor.

units.source_text: 他常常在想：“此人与皇女并肩，毫无不相称之处。

en.t: He often thought, "If this man stood beside an imperial princess, there would be nothing at all unsuitable about the match.
Although he already has someone to whom his heart is attached,

units.source_text: 但决不会冷遇我女，做出有损名望的事来。

en.t: he would certainly never treat my daughter coldly or do anything that would damage her reputation.

units.source_text: 他终非有个正夫人不可，还不如趁他未曾定亲以前先向他隐约示意吧。”

en.t: In the end he must have a lawful wife, so it would be better to hint this to him before he becomes formally engaged."
